Service 03 • Real Estate & Joint Ventures

Land Sales & Joint Work in Jharkhand & West Bengal

Facilitating clear-title land acquisition, verified property sales, and structured joint venture partnerships for commercial, residential, and industrial ventures.

Verified Titles • Fair Partnerships

Clear Title Land Deals & Joint Ventures

Real estate ventures in eastern India require thorough on-ground due diligence, revenue-sharing precision, and authentic local network. GB Group connects reputable landowners with experienced builders, corporations, and investors across Jharkhand and West Bengal.

Land Buying & Selling: Complete verification of deed chains, mutation, and government clearances.
Joint Venture (JV) Collaboration: Fair ratio agreements (sharing of constructed area or revenue).

Land Buying & Selling Services

Assisting buyers and sellers with end-to-end procedural transparency:

  • Title & Deed Verification: 30-year deed search, verification of legal ownership, and non-encumbrance.
  • Zoning & Classification: Clarifying commercial, residential, industrial, and agricultural classification.
  • Fair Market Valuation: Accurate guidance on circle rates and realistic market prices.
  • Dispute-Free Assurance: Thorough checks on possession status and boundary demarcation.

Joint Venture & Joint Work (JV)

Unlocking the potential of prime land parcels through builder collaboration:

  • Matching Landowners with Credible Builders: Partnering with developers with proven track records.
  • Transparent Joint Venture Agreements: Drafting airtight contracts with clear timelines and sharing ratios.
  • Commercial & Residential Projects: IT towers, residential apartment blocks, shopping malls, warehouses.
  • Project Monitoring: Ensuring milestone compliance from sanctioned plans to completion.
